text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky and I decide to visit a shrine for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This weather's just perfect for basking in the sun.
choice_data_list: Shall we go make a prayer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'll pass. I'm not really one for divine providence and whatnot.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Please, bring me victory in my next race!
choice_data_list: Oh, looks like someone else is here.
Oh, looks like someone else is here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yup, they're praying real hard too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Seiun Sky. And how long have you been here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wasn't expecting to bump into you here. Praying for a win, huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Heavens, as if I'd need to pray for such a thing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I simply came here for a moment of peace. I thought that perhaps some repose might be necessary to ensure victory.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And I've now given the gods the opportunity to grant my noble wishes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. Like the final prep before you step out onto the track.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, something like that. You should take this opportunity to reflect on yourself as well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now then, if you'll excuse me. Ohoho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I guess she wouldn't be King if she did it any other way. Still…
choice_data_list: There might be something you can learn from her.
There might be something you can learn from her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, she's one to keep an eye on…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Welp, maybe I'll do a little praying myself. ♪ Haven't been feeling that good lately.
And so, Seiun Sky and I pray together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: 'Kay, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I'm actually feeling pretty good now! I guess coming to the shrine for a break wasn't such a bad idea.
In high spirits again, Seiun Sky looks as if she's back to her old self.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I'm not feeling too different…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose it's not like praying's the kinda thing that works in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
choice_data_list: Was that a black cat that just crossed our path?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! Don't get all spooked. Them being bad luck's just some old wives' tale.
Whether black cats are bad luck or not, Seiun Sky's condition doesn't improve.
